overview.description: The China AI Tigers LLM ETF (TGRZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is an actively managed ETF providing concentrated exposure to Chinese companies at the forefront of artificial intelligence. The ETF targets industry leaders within China's AI ecosystem through a proprietary selection process. TGRZ was launched on Aug 25, 2026 and is issued by EMXETF.
